description_for_human: Suche und Prozessunterstützung für Cernion Energy: Unternehmen, VDMI, ZNP, Netzanschluss.
description_for_model:
Use this plugin to search and navigate Cernion energy management data and to initiate controlled process workflows.

SEARCH: Call searchCernionData to find companies, VNBs, VDMI matrices, ZNP projects, grid connection validations, and EDM MeLo IDs. All search results carry id, title, excerpt, domain, type, status, and url.

READ-ONLY PROCESS ACTIONS: Use getVdmiContext, listOpenResponsibilities, getZnpProjectStatus, and getGridConnectionValidation to load current state before proposing any action.

DRAFT/PROPOSE: prepareVdmiValidation and draftVdmiEvidence return draft proposals only — no writes. prepareGridConnectionValidation returns a configuration draft only. All draft responses include requiredConfirmation and an auditTrail.

SAFETY RULES:
- Always load context (getVdmiContext / getZnpProjectStatus) before drafting a process action.
- Always summarise target, intended change, and risk to the user before calling a draft action.
- Draft actions with requiredConfirmation: true require explicit user approval before the consequential Phase-3 execute action is called.
- DO NOT call consequential execute actions directly — they are not yet implemented.
- DO NOT perform bulk changes, mass nominates, or irreversible actions.

functions.name: searchCernionData
functions.description: Search across Cernion energy management entities (companies, VNBs, VDMI matrices, ZNP projects, grid connection validations, EDM MeLo IDs). Returns id, title, excerpt, type, status, and url to the detail endpoint for each hit.

functions.name: getVdmiContext
functions.description: Load full VDMI matrix context: status, open tasks, nomination state, evidence count. Call before drafting any VDMI process action.

functions.name: listOpenResponsibilities
functions.description: List VDMI matrices where the current user or a named actor has open Verantwortlich tasks.

functions.name: getZnpProjectStatus
functions.description: Get ZNP project metadata and graph statistics (nodes, edges, loaded layers). Read-only.

functions.name: getGridConnectionValidation
functions.description: Retrieve a grid connection validation report by ID: decision, findings count, grid operator name. Read-only.

functions.name: prepareVdmiValidation
functions.description: Prepare a VDMI matrix nomination draft. Returns a structured proposal with requiredConfirmation: true. No writes. Requires explicit user approval before Phase-3 execute.

functions.name: draftVdmiEvidence
functions.description: Generate evidence suggestions for open VDMI matrix tasks. Returns a list of per-task evidence recommendations. No writes, requiredConfirmation: false.

functions.name: prepareGridConnectionValidation
functions.description: Prepare a grid connection validation run configuration. Returns a draft with requiredConfirmation: true. No writes. Requires explicit user approval before Phase-3 execute.
